question: Which deities are invoked to protect the eyes and nose?
premises: The boon-giver is asked to protect the eyes.
The one affectionate to devotees is asked to protect the nose.
Each body part is assigned a protective deity.
inference: Protection of the eyes and nose is sought from the boon-giver and the devotee-affectionate goddess.
plain_english: May the boon-giver protect my eyes, and may she who is affectionate to devotees protect my nose.
